newsitem.title: USA: Hycor gets FDA okay to market allergy test.
newsitem.headline: Hycor gets FDA okay to market allergy test.

text.p: Hycor Biomedical Inc said Tuesday it has received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its latex allergy test in the United States.

"The incidence of latex sensitivity is on the rise, especially among health care professionals who are exposed to products containing latex," Hycor chairman Richard Hamill said in a written statement. "Adverse allergic reactions to latex can be serious."
"The goal of medical professionals is to determine who is most likely to develop serious reactions from contact with latex and take steps to avoid the risk," he said.
Hycor Biomedical specializes in the development, production and worldwide marketing of medical diagnostic products, it said.
